_comment: The COBOL precompiler, split from the interpreter so the two mutation targets run in parallel and each remains inside the scheduled job's three-hour bound.
_incremental_comment: Off, deliberately. Stryker's incremental cache is keyed on the code it mutates, and these lanes exist to measure whether the tests are worth anything, so a test-only change must re-measure. CI uses a fresh runner and has no cache to reuse.
